description: The pressure–RF association should remain screened out because it did not reproduce with stable direction and magnitude across development periods.
mechanistic_interpretations: The candidate may reflect a conditionally active environmental regime rather than a stable pressure-linked RF mechanism.
alternative_explanations: The original association may be a development-period fluctuation that does not generalize across time.
The pressure variable may be acting as a proxy for a broader time-varying environmental regime rather than as the relevant physical driver.
The apparent relation may depend on how RF degradation is defined, even if the original exploratory association looked coherent.
falsification_tests: blocked_temporal_replication: require a newly registered formulation to preserve effect direction across prespecified contiguous temporal blocks.
outcome_definition_sensitivity: test whether the qualitative association persists under prespecified alternative RF outcome definitions.
prospective_new_data_replication: only a newly frozen formulation may be tested on future data; the failed formulation remains screened out.
uncertainties: The failed replication does not distinguish between a false exploratory association and a real effect that is strongly regime-dependent.
